fixes.new: Retention across schemas (JOB-17; GAP-0182). Retention is owned by P5 `rwb-document`, and the owner of each schema acts on its own rows: no service writes another service's tables (DP-01; ADR-014). Until an expiry event is added to the event catalog, the P5 retention decision reaches the owning service over that service's REST contract, in one hop with a 2 s timeout (DP-11). The operation that receives the decision is not published in API Specification v5: its method, path and operationId are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0182), and T5.2.3 does not count it.

disposition.note: Rule added under T5.2.2. Receiving operation is not named in the item, so left unspecified; API Specification and event catalog changes belong to those documents.
